title: HR Compliance Action Plan
description: A policy-grounded action plan drafted by an LLM from retrieved HR policy text. Every action must cite the clause it derives from.

eventId.description: Stable identifier for the originating event, conventionally employeeId-effectiveDate.

eventType.description: The HR lifecycle event that triggered this plan.

effectiveDate.description: ISO date the event takes effect. Every deadline is computed from this anchor.

actions.description: Required actions. An empty array is valid and correct when the retrieved policy text does not cover the situation.

actionType.description: Must be one of the known action types. Unknown values are rejected rather than coerced.

deadline.description: ISO date by which the action must be completed. Must equal effectiveDate plus deadlineRuleDays.

deadlineRuleDays.description: The day offset stated in the cited policy clause. Recorded separately from the computed deadline so the arithmetic can be independently verified.

sourceClause.description: Verbatim text of the policy clause this action derives from. Without a citation an action cannot be executed.

sourceDocument.description: Filename of the policy document containing the cited clause.

confidence.description: Model confidence. Actions below 0.7 are routed to manual review rather than executed.
